tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind content and the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, form sections, tables, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table header rows, read-only and locked fields, code wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts. Always with shadow-pop.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: White plate under signature images and uploaded documents so the ink stays readable in dark mode.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card edges, section dividers. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and toggle-track borders. 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Help text, timestamps, table meta, placeholder-adjacent labels on all four grounds (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav item marker, links, success state, checked toggles. USC green deepened for 5.4:1 on surface (light).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Dark theme uses dark text on the lighter green.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item background, Approved badge, success banners.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft (7:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, error text, field error borders, overdue dates. USC red deepened for text contrast.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Disapproved / Lapsed badge, error banners, void-signature notice.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons, 'Under review' state. USC blue deepened.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Submitted / Under screening / Under review badges, info banners.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due-soon dates, 'Awaiting revision' and 'Returned' text. Gold deepened to read on light grounds.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Awaiting revision / Returned badges, due-soon banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every focusable element; 4.6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Logo green. Decorative fills only (cover, illustrations, the 3px sidebar brand rule). Never text: 3.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Logo red. Decorative only; use danger for meaning.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue. Decorative only; use info for meaning.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Logo star gold. One small accent per screen at most (the star mark, a new-item dot). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the mobile nav drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign-in page and empty-state headlines only.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Field group labels, table column headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Please indicate the page and paragraph where this information can be found.
styles.usage: Default text, form answers, long instructions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Juan D. Cruz, Juana S. Santos
styles.usage: Table cells, sidebar items, dense lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges, buttons small, meta.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Protocol codes, form codes (F-35), version labels (2/28May2022), verify references.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding inline; table cell padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap between fields; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between page title and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; top of auth pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Rare: hero spacing on the sign-in page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, badges, checkboxes (checkbox 4px inner).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, menus, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and the sign-in card only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, role chips, avatar stacks.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs. Cards use a border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Button press-in (scale down).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover color changes, checkbox tick.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Toggles, tabs indicator, badge changes, menu open.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Sidebar expand/collapse, drawer, page content enter.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Blur-to-sharp when loaded content replaces its placeholder.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for color, opacity and layout transitions.

tokens.name: ease-out-soft
tokens.usage: Entering elements: sidebar, drawer, menus, content reveal.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Bouncy overshoot: toggle thumb, button release, check mark, selected nav marker.

tokens.name: blur-loading
tokens.usage: Placeholder content shown blurred while data loads (first load).

tokens.name: blur-stale
tokens.usage: Existing content while it refreshes (filters, pagination). Paired with opacity 0.7.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded vertical navigation.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed navigation (icons only, tooltips on hover).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with breadcrumbs, search, notifications, theme switch.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs; 44px on touch (pointer: coarse).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; forms 760px.
